title: Information Content of Trading Activity in Precious Metals Futures Markets
about: Regime-dependent return prediction from volume, open interest and trader positions.
findings: Author reports asymmetric Granger relationships across bull/bear states. This is not a costed OOS native trading result.
mechanism: Informed trades could continue while noninformational demand reverses; regime recognition must be causal.
build_on: GC volume overlaps only part of the specification. Daily OI, exact causal regime fit and published full rules are not authenticated; no volume-only rescue.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Conditional research model only; filtered states, matured labels, release vintages and executable payoff rules are needed.
